# Home Designing

> Home Designing is an interior design inspiration platform offering curated design guides, home tours, and decorating ideas across multiple styles and room types.

The site features both aspirational home tours showcasing architectural and design excellence, as well as practical how-to guides covering everything from color theory and furniture styling to organization systems. Content spans minimalist, modern, neoclassical, and japandi design aesthetics with product recommendations from retailers like Wayfair, Amazon, and Houzz.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design
- Home Decor
- Minimalist Design
- Modern Style
- Home Tours
- Design Inspiration
- Storage Solutions
- Product Recommendations
- Interior Styling
- Decorating Ideas
- Design Trends
- Residential Design
- Room Design
- Japandi
- Neoclassical

## Core Pages

- [Home Interior Design Ideas & Decorating Inspiration](https://www.home-designing.com): Homepage showcasing interior design ideas, decor inspiration across multiple room types and design styles.
- [About | Interior Design Ideas](https://www.home-designing.com/about-us): About page for Home Designing with company mission, community, and social media presence.

## Design Technique & Color Guides

- [The Color Drenching Room: 18 Ways to Go All-In on One Color](https://www.home-designing.com/the-color-drenching-room-18-ways-to-go-all-in-on-one-color-without-losing-your-mind): Article exploring color drenching technique with 18 monochromatic design room examples.
- [Curtains That Make a Room Look Expensive](https://www.home-designing.com/curtains-that-make-a-room-look-expensive): Guide to affordable curtain options from Wayfair and CB2 for polished room styling.
- [The Inherited Furniture Dilemma: 17 Ways to Honor Gifts Without Sacrificing Style](https://www.home-designing.com/the-inherited-furniture-dilemma-17-ways-to-honor-gifts-without-sacrificing-style): Article with 17 strategies for styling inherited furniture into modern home design.

- [The Adult ADHD Home: 19 Design Systems That Work With Your Brain](https://www.home-designing.com/the-adult-adhd-home-19-design-systems-that-work-with-your-brain): Design guide with 19 ADHD-friendly systems for organized, functional spaces.
- [The New Threshold: 18 Entryway Design Solutions for Our Stranger-at-the-Door Lives](https://www.home-designing.com/the-new-threshold-18-entryway-design-solutions-for-our-stranger-at-the-door-lives): Article with 18 entryway design ideas for modern secure and stylish home entries.
